summary: Aalto University in Finland awards Excellence Scholarships as waivers of the full tuition fee, for three years of a bachelor's or two of a master's. They are merit-based and competitive, and you must ask for one on your admission application.
meta_title: Aalto Excellence Scholarship 2027: full tuition fee waiver in Finland
meta_description: Aalto's Excellence Scholarship waives the full tuition fee. Master's applications for autumn 2027 run 7 December 2026 to 5 January 2027; documents by 12 Jan.
covers: The full tuition fee, for three years of a bachelor's or two years of a master's.
It continues during exchange or internship periods.
Living costs are not covered; Aalto says to plan for at least €800 a month.
eligibility: Tuition-fee-liable students, generally citizens of countries outside the EU/EEA.
Selection is on merit and is competitive, and a programme may decide not to award any.
You must study full time with an approved personal study plan.
Applicants admitted from a waiting list cannot receive one.
how_to_apply: Apply to your Aalto master's between 7 December 2026, 9:00, and 5 January 2027, 15:00 (UTC+2).
Choose the scholarship option on the application form during that period. You cannot get a scholarship if you did not apply for it then.
Upload all application documents by 12 January 2027, 15:00 (UTC+2).
Results come on 30 March 2027 at the earliest; bachelor's applicants should check Aalto's own bachelor's admission dates.
watch_out: It is not automatic: forget the option on the form and you cannot get it.
Missing documents after 12 January 2027 mean your application is rejected as incomplete.
Without the scholarship, a master's costs €15,000 to €20,000 a year at the rates Aalto lists.
costs: Tuition fee: €15,000 to €20,000 a year for a master's, €12,000 to €15,000 for a bachelor's
The scholarship, in full, if you win it
Living costs in Finland, at least €800 a month
You; the scholarship does not cover them
documents: Your Aalto application, with the scholarship option chosen, by 5 January 2027.
The application documents your programme asks for, uploaded by 12 January 2027.

faq.q: Is the Aalto Excellence Scholarship a full waiver?
faq.a: Yes. Aalto says the scholarships are awarded as tuition fee waivers that cover the full tuition fee, for the normal length of the degree. They do not cover living costs.
No. You must select the scholarship option on your admission application during the application period.
